seo.description: Remote Chinese-language legal consultation. The initial assessment can be completed by WeChat video, Zoom or phone without travelling to the office.

coverage.title: Where we serve
coverage.subtitle: NYC Chinese communities and the wider New York area
coverage.body: Our office is in Middletown, New York, and we primarily serve New York City's Chinese communities. For clients who cannot travel, the initial assessment and most subsequent communication can be handled remotely. Where documents need signing or a meeting is required, we arrange it separately.

items.title: WeChat video
items.desc: Use the app you already have — no extra software, and you can send documents and screenshots as you go.

items.title: Zoom
items.desc: Best when we need to look at a contract together; screen sharing lets us go through it clause by clause.

items.title: Phone
items.desc: If video isn't convenient, just call 845-299-9888 and describe the situation.

promise.title: Remote doesn't change what we can do
promise.body: The first conversation does a fixed set of things: understand what happened, organise the timeline and documents, explain the usual process, and identify whether an attorney is needed. All of that works just as well by phone or video. Meeting an attorney or signing documents is arranged separately by the partner firm.

cta.title: Book a remote consultation
cta.subtitle: Tell us what happened and we'll help you see the options. The initial assessment is free.
